description: This Java class functions as a JSF managed bean controller for a Todo List application, handling user interactions, data binding, and integrating with in-memory data management. It manages TodoItem objects and responds to UI events such as row selection and button actions.

classes.name: TodoListController
classes.description: A JSF managed bean controller for managing Todo items within a web interface, supporting CRUD operations and row selection features.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of TodoItems managed by the controller.

methods.name: buttonUpdateAction
methods.description: Triggers an update of selected TodoItems via the management service.

methods.name: buttonAddAction
methods.description: Creates a new TodoItem with current 'name' and 'category' and adds it to the list.

methods.name: setSelectedItems
methods.description: Sets the list of selected TodoItems.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of selected TodoItems.

methods.name: onRowSelect
methods.description: Handles row selection event, displaying a message with the selected item's ID.

methods.name: onRowUnselect
methods.description: Handles row unselection event, displaying a message with the unselected item's ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current 'name' string used for creating new TodoItems.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the 'name' string for creating new TodoItems.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the current 'category' string used for creating new TodoItems.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the 'category' string for creating new TodoItems.
